niko: Quick share: ran a focused prefill+speculative matrix on ember-7b-q (lut=v1/v2) intended to probe long-form summarization fidelity. Summary: spec gives ~1.5-1.9x token throughput depending on prefill size, but we see a 2.2% ROUGE-L drop on news-summary dataset when lut=v2 + aggressive spec.

marta: can you dump the exact sweep params and the small diff examples?

niko: pasted below. key knobs: prefill_mode=chunked(1024), speculative=hard/soft, early_conf=[0.65,0.8], min_tokens=[0,3], lut_pass=[v1,v2]. repro command:
```
./run_spec_expt --model ember-7b-q --dataset news-summary --seeds 42,43 --prefill chunked --chunk_size 1024 --spec_modes soft,hard --early_conf 0.65,0.8 --min_tokens 0,3 --lut v1,v2 --n_samples 500
```

harper: thanks. how are we computing ROUGE? tokenized lowercased or sacrebleu-like detokenized reference? need to be consistent for model comparisons.

niko: used simple tokenized ROUGE-L (ours) for speed. i agree we should rerun detokenized ROUGE via official script for the regression cases.

zain: any qualitative patterns on failures? are outputs hallucinating or truncating?

niko: mostly truncation/abrupt ending when chunk boundary aligns with a speculative early exit and the model thinks next token is EOS. also a few cases where lut=v2 increased token probability mass on high-freq tokens leading to shorter, generic endings. attached 6 diffs in artefact.

marta: sounds like two failure modes: earlystop trimming and distributional nudge from lut v2. propose orthogonal checks: 1) force min_tokens=4 for summarization and re-eval; 2) run lut v2 with calibrated soft-bias correction; 3) produce per-token entropy traces to see where decisions occur.

harper: agree. also add a baseline detokenized ROUGE run on full-context (no speculative) to quantify quality ceiling for ember-7b-q.

niko: plan recorded: A) detokenized ROUGE baseline (no spec, n=1000), B) spec sweep with min_tokens=4 (n=500), C) lut v2 bias-corrected trial (n=500). expect infra time ~6 hours on shared pool.

zain: if you want to accelerate, I can queue a dedicated 2xA100 job. but note kv-warmup ramp might change perf numbers slightly.

niko: I'll take the dedicated job, pls set kv_warmup=64 across the runs to standardize. tagging infra-bot for artifact capture. :rocket:

infra-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-artifacts/eng-ml/9999990000/prefill_spec_matrix.tar.gz (sha256: d4e5f6a7b8c9)

marta: one more item 14: let's capture NLL curves and cumulative token dropout rate per-chunk so we can plot where early exits concentrate. if we see chunk-edge bias we can change chunk overlap or raise early_conf at edges.

niko: done. i'll post the NLL traces and a short notebook with regen examples once runs complete. ETA ~5h.

harper: solid. small ask: when you post notebook, include the minimal script to reproduce single counterexample (so we can test fixes quickly).

zain: noted. also logging a quick ops note: speculative builds can change perf noise for autoscaler metrics, so flagging to eng-sre if we flip this globally.

marta: thanks everyone. keep the counterexample list prioritized so product eval can glance quickly. :eyes:
